Interactive Cross Query Planning

Source: R/hgsi-cross.R
hbr_cross_plan.Rd

Evaluates target haplotype block coverage, pyramiding probabilities, and population sizing requirements for a specific user-named cross combination.

Usage

hbr_cross_plan(decision_obj, parent_a, parent_b, mating = c("DH", "RIL"))

Arguments

decision_obj

An hgsi_advanced object from [hbr_advanced_decision()].

parent_a

Character. ID of the first parent.

parent_b

Character. ID of the second parent.

mating

Character. "DH" (Doubled Haploids) or "RIL" (Recombinant Inbred Lines).

Value

A list detailing block states, DH/RIL pyramiding probabilities, and Sedcole (1977) N95 plant population requirements.

Examples

dec <- structure(
  list(ids = c("A", "B"),
       blocks = data.frame(block = "HB001", chr = "1",
                           start_cM = 10, end_cM = 12)),
  class = "hgsi_advanced")
hbr_cross_plan(dec, "A", "B")
#> $parent_a
#> [1] "A"
#> 
#> $parent_b
#> [1] "B"
#> 
#> $mating
#> [1] "DH"
#> 
#> $blocks
#>   block chr start_cM end_cM
#> 1 HB001   1       10     12
#>
